department: Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering (Data Science)

deadline.value: Apply by January 15, 2027 for Fall admission.
deadline.quote: Application Deadlines | January 15 for the following Fall semester | Bioinformatics | Computer Science | Data Science | Health Informatics | Human-Computer Interaction | Information Science

gre_general.value: Taking the GRE General Test is optional for Data Science Ph.D. candidates.
gre_general.quote: Taking the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) General Test (Quantitative, Verbal, and Analytical Writing) is optional for candidates.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for Data Science.
gre_subject.quote: Taking the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) General Test (Quantitative, Verbal, and Analytical Writing) is optional for candidates.

also.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The Luddy School does not state whether a faculty advisor must be secured prior to applying.

funding.value: Qualified full-time Ph.D. applicants who apply by the deadline are automatically considered for Ph.D. fellowships that include tuition reimbursement and a monthly stipend.
funding.quote: We offer fellowships to qualified, full-time Ph.D. students. To be automatically considered for a fellowship, Ph.D. applicants must submit their application by the deadline. Ph.D. fellowships include tuition reimbursement and a monthly stipend for work with a graduate faculty member.

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree (master's degree preferred) with a minimum 3.5 GPA.
entry_route.quote: Data Science | A bachelor's degree; master's preferred | Overall GPA of 3.5 or higher on a 4.0 scale
